name: Adaptive Reflexes

requirements.text: Missing Hand, Arm, Foot, or Leg

description: You’ve learned to endure and overcome your disability. If you lost your foot or leg, you are no longer limited to moving only 20 feet on a turn. If you lost your hand or foot: you gain 3 points which you can use to increase any of your ability scores by the amount used. If you lost your arm or leg: you gain 5 points which you can use to increase any of your ability scores by the amount used.

effects.text: Pick-time choice: distribute 3 points (lost hand or foot) or 5 points (lost arm or leg) among ability scores, per missing limb. Foot or leg loss no longer limits movement to 20 feet.

requirementText: Missing Hand, Arm, Foot, or Leg

repeat.text: You can take this perk as many times as you have missing arms or legs.

name: Blind Devil
description: Attuning to your loss of sight has made your other senses sharper. You can sense your surroundings with pinpoint accuracy. You can effectively “see” any target within a number of feet of you equal to 5 x your Perception ability score. Additionally, your passive sense increases by 5 and you have advantage on all your combat sequence rolls.

effects.text: You can "see" any target within 5 x your Perception score feet.

name: Cowboy
description: Whenever you spend AP to draw a lever action rifle, cowboy repeater, or revolver, the AP cost is reduced to 1. Additionally, if you attack and hit a surprised creature with a lever action rifle, cowboy repeater, or revolver; the attack critically hits.

effects.text: Drawing a lever action rifle, cowboy repeater or revolver costs 1 AP. Attacks that hit a surprised creature with those weapons critically hit.

name: Deadeye
description: Whenever you roll attack or damage with a ranged weapon, add 2 to the result. Additionally, whenever you make a targeted attack roll to the head with a ranged weapon, add an additional 2 to the result.

effects.text: +2 to attack and damage rolls with ranged weapons per rank; an extra +2 per rank on targeted attack rolls to the head with ranged weapons.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of three times

name: Duelist
description: Whenever you roll attack or damage with an unarmed or melee weapon, add 2 to the result.

effects.text: +2 to attack and damage rolls with unarmed or melee weapons per rank.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of three times

name: Educated
description: You gain 4 skill points when you reach 5th, 9th, 13th, 17th, 21st, 25th, and 29th level instead of 3. Additionally, you gain a number of skill points equal to the total available at your level as if your Intelligence ability score is equal to 5. (Use the Level Up table on page # for reference).

effects.text: 4 skill points per grant instead of 3, and retroactive points as if INT were 5. The modifier adds 1 per grant reached on top of the base 3 (requires INT 4 or lower).

name: Entomologist
description: You know the anatomy of various instincts. Whenever you roll damage from an attack roll against the hit points of a creature with the insect creature type, their DT is not subtracted from your damage total. (Insects include Ants, Bloatflies, Cazador, Radscorpion, etc.)

effects.text: Damage rolled against insects ignores their DT.

name: Fight the Power!
description: You've had enough of these so-called "authorities"! Whenever you take damage to your hit points from a creature affiliated to a faction, your DT is increased by 1. Additionally, whenever you deal damage to a creature affiliated to a faction, the damage increases by 1. (Faction examples include the NCR, Brotherhood of Steel, Caesar’s Legion, Institute, or Railroad. Up to GM’s discretion.)

effects.text: Per rank: +1 DT against damage to HP from faction-affiliated creatures, and +1 damage to faction-affiliated creatures.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of twice.

name: Here and Now
description: You and each other player character immediately gain 1000 XP. Once this perk has been taken, it cannot be taken again by any other player characters.

effects.text: On pick, you and each other PC immediately gain 1000 XP.

repeat.text: Once this perk has been taken, it cannot be taken again by any other player characters.

name: Purifier
description: Whenever you make an attack roll with an unarmed or melee weapon against an abomination, add 3 to the result. (Abominations include Super mutants, Deathclaws, Mirelurks, Fog crawlers, etc.)

effects.text: +3 per rank to unarmed or melee attack rolls against abominations.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of three times.

name: Sneering Imperialist
description: You don't take kindly to raiders, junkies, or freeloaders. Whenever you roll damage from an attack roll against a humanoid with no affiliation to a faction, add 3 to the result.

effects.text: +3 per rank to damage from attack rolls against humanoids with no faction affiliation.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of twice.

name: Swift Learner
description: Whenever the GM awards XP, you and each other player character gain an additional 20% bonus.

effects.text: Whenever the GM awards XP, you and each other PC gain an additional 20% bonus.

repeat.text: This perk can be taken up to a maximum of twice by one player character or once by a total of two player characters.

name: Heavyweight
description: You can spend 6 action points to make a special unarmed attack called a heavy unarmed attack. A heavy unarmed attack is identical to an unarmed attack but the damage is increased by 2d4. Additionally, you are immune to the encumbered condition. However, you can still gain the heavily encumbered condition.

effects.text: Spend 6 AP for a heavy unarmed attack: an unarmed attack with damage increased by 2d4. You can still become heavily encumbered.

name: Weapon Handling
description: It’s not about size, it’s about how you use it. You no longer have disadvantage on attack rolls made with weapons that you do not meet the Strength requirement for. Additionally, you ignore the negative effects of the first two levels of decay with all weapons.

effects.text: No disadvantage on attack rolls with weapons whose Strength requirement you don't meet. Ignore the negative effects of the first two levels of decay on all weapons.

name: Butcher
description: You’re hackin’, whackin’, and choppin’ that meat! Whenever you roll damage from an attack roll made with a melee weapon, add 2 to the result. Additionally, if you make a targeted attack with a bladed melee weapon to a creature's arms or legs and deal more than double their level in points of damage to the creature's hit points, you sever the limb!

effects.text: +2 to damage rolls from melee weapon attacks. A targeted bladed melee attack to an arm or leg that deals more than double the creature's level in HP damage severs the limb.

name: Fisticuffs
description: Give ‘em the one-two! Whenever you roll damage from an attack roll made with an unarmed attack and the damage is dealt to a target’s stamina points, add 3 to the result. Additionally, if you make a targeted attack with an unarmed attack to a creature's head and deal more than their level in points of damage to the creature's hit points, they become dazed for a number of rounds equal to their 8 - their Endurance ability score (minimum of 1).

effects.text: +3 to damage rolls from unarmed attacks that damage a target's stamina points. A targeted unarmed attack to the head dealing more than the creature's level in HP damage makes it dazed for 8 - its Endurance score rounds (minimum 1).

name: Heave Ho!
description: What a pitch! Whenever you throw an object or creature; the distance you can throw it is doubled.

effects.text: The distance you can throw an object or creature is doubled.

name: Hauler
description: Your maximum carry load increases by 50. Additionally, when you carry heavy objects you do not become slowed.

effects.text: You don't become slowed when carrying heavy objects.

name: Assert Power
description: You can spend 4 action points on your turn to frighten a target creature that is within 30 feet of you. (See page # for the frightened condition). You cannot frighten a creature you have already frightened.

effects.text: Spend 4 AP to frighten a creature within 30 feet. You can't frighten a creature you have already frightened.

name: Leaping Powerhouse
description: You’ve got the strongest knees in the wasteland! Whenever you long jump you can clear an additional 10 feet and whenever you high jump you can clear an additional 3 feet. Additionally, whenever you take impact damage from a fall, you take half as much.

effects.text: Long jumps clear an additional 10 feet and high jumps an additional 3 feet. Impact damage from falls is halved.

name: Super Slam!
description: If you spend your action points to move at least 15 feet in a straight line, your next unarmed or melee weapon attack has advantage. If this attack hits and deals damage to the creature's hit points, you may choose for the target to either fall prone or be knocked back a number of feet equal to 5 x your Strength ability modifier.

effects.text: After spending AP to move at least 15 feet in a straight line, your next unarmed or melee weapon attack has advantage. If it hits and damages HP, the target falls prone or is knocked back 5 x your Strength modifier feet.

name: Stonewall
description: Your damage threshold increases by 2, and whenever you roll a Strength or Ability check to resist being grappled, restrained, or knocked prone; you have advantage or you may flip one of your Karma Caps to automatically succeed.

effects.text: Advantage on Strength or ability checks to resist being grappled, restrained or knocked prone, or flip a Karma Cap to automatically succeed.

name: K.O
description: Whenever you deal damage to a target creature's hit points for the first time from an attack roll with an unarmed or melee weapon attack, they become dazed for 2 rounds.

effects.text: The first time you deal damage to a creature's HP with an unarmed or melee weapon attack, it becomes dazed for 2 rounds.

name: Piercing Strikes
description: You know how to make devastating attacks through blocks. Whenever you deal damage from an unarmed or melee weapon attack, the target’s DT is subtracted by a number equal to your Strength ability modifier to a minimum of 0.

effects.text: Unarmed and melee weapon damage reduces the target's DT by your Strength modifier (minimum DT 0).

name: Paralyzing Punch
description: If you hit a single target creature with at least three melee attacks on a turn, they gain 2 levels of fatigue. If a creature reaches 4 levels of fatigue in this way; they become paralyzed until the end of their next turn. Once a creature has become paralyzed in this way, they cannot become paralyzed again until you roll combat sequence.

effects.text: Hitting a single target with at least three melee attacks in a turn gives it 2 levels of fatigue. At 4 levels of fatigue this way it is paralyzed until the end of its next turn, and can't be paralyzed this way again until you roll combat sequence.

name: Rooted
description: You're part tree! You can spend 4 action points on your turn to become Rooted. While Rooted, your DT increases by 5 and any damage you deal from an attack made with an unarmed or melee weapon is increased by 2. However, moving 5 feet costs 2 action points. You can spend 3 action points to remove the Rooted condition.

effects.text: Spend 4 AP to become Rooted (3 AP to end it). While Rooted: +5 DT, +2 damage on unarmed and melee weapon attacks, and moving 5 feet costs 2 AP.

name: Unstoppable Force
description: Your martial might is truly legendary. Whenever you roll damage from an unarmed or melee weapon attack roll against the hit points of a creature, their DT is not subtracted from your damage total

effects.text: Damage from unarmed and melee weapon attacks against a creature's HP ignores its DT.

name: Never Unarmed
description: Anything can be a weapon if you’re holding it right. Whenever you make an attack roll with an improvised weapon, the damage is increased by 1 die rank and the critical hit chance is decreased by 1.

effects.text: Attacks with an improvised weapon increase damage by 1 die rank and decrease critical hit chance by 1.

name: Living Weapons
description: You can use other creatures as improved weapons. If they are unwilling, you must succeed a grapple check to use them as an improvised weapon. Using a creature as an improved weapon costs 6 AP, uses your Melee Weapons skill to hit, critically hits on 20 (x2), and deals a number of d6’s of impact damage depending on their size. Small creatures deal 3d6 impact damage, medium creatures deal 4d6 impact damage, and large creatures deal 5d6 impact damage (you cannot use a creature huge or greater as an improvised weapon). You can also throw them a number of feet equal to 2 x your Strength score. If you throw a creature into another creature and deal impact damage to their hit points, they both fall prone. Whenever a creature is used as an improved weapon, they take half of the impact damage dealt to their hit points.

effects.text: Use a creature as an improvised weapon (grapple check if unwilling): 6 AP, Melee Weapons skill, crit 20 (x2), impact damage 3d6 small / 4d6 medium / 5d6 large (not huge or larger). Throw them 2 x your Strength score feet; a creature thrown into another and dealing impact damage to HP makes both fall prone. The used creature takes half the impact damage dealt to HP.

name: Slayer
description: The slayer walks the earth. Whenever you spend action points to attack with an unarmed or melee weapon attack, you gain 1 action point. Additionally, your critical hit chance with all unarmed and melee weapons decreases by 1.

effects.text: Gain 1 AP whenever you spend AP to make an unarmed or melee weapon attack. Critical hit chance with all unarmed and melee weapons decreases by 1.

name: Careful Aim
description: You take your time to attack, allowing you to be more accurate. Whenever you spend action points to make an attack roll with a ranged weapon, you can spend 1 additional action point to add 1 to the result of the roll. You can spend up to 3 additional action points to add an additional 1 to the attack per action point used.

effects.text: Ranged weapon attacks: spend 1 extra AP to add 1 to the attack roll, up to 3 extra AP (+3 total).

name: Friend of the Night
description: You’ve adapted to low-light conditions and you know how to utilize the darkness to your advantage. You no longer have disadvantage on any attack rolls, ability checks, or skill checks inhibited by low-light conditions.

effects.text: No disadvantage on attack rolls, ability checks or skill checks from low-light conditions. Second rank: night vision out to 100 feet.

repeat.text: If you take this perk again, you’ve mutated or upgraded to adapt to the darkness. You have night vision out to 100 feet.

name: Alertness
description: You've learned to keep your senses alert to any danger. If you do not move from a singular location no larger than a 20 foot radius for at least 10 minutes; you gain a bonus to your passive sense equal to your Perception ability score. (Simply put, your passive sense is equal to 12 + double your Perception ability modifier)

effects.text: After staying within a 20 foot radius for at least 10 minutes, passive sense gains a bonus (rulebook text says your Perception score, but its parenthetical gives 12 + double your Perception modifier, i.e. a bonus equal to modPER; see ERRATA E17).

name: Infiltrator
description: You can get in and out of places with ease. You can spend 3 action points and examine a lock or computer within 5 feet of you to learn the Breach DC. Additionally, whenever you fail a Breach check, you can flip one of your Karma Caps to automatically succeed instead.

effects.text: Spend 3 AP and examine a lock or computer within 5 feet to learn its Breach DC. On a failed Breach check, flip a Karma Cap to succeed instead.

name: Empowered Energy
description: Whenever you roll damage from an attack from an energy weapon, you can roll an additional damage dice. Additionally, whenever you critically hit with an energy weapon you can choose to either make an additional attack (up to a maximum of one per turn) or double the critical hit damage.

effects.text: Energy weapon damage rolls get one additional damage die per rank. On a critical hit with an energy weapon, make one extra attack (max one per turn) or double the critical damage.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of three times, each time increasing your energy weapon damage dice by one.

name: Standoff
description: You’ve got a nose for trouble. Whenever you roll Combat Sequence, you and one other creature within 30 feet of you gains a bonus equal to your Perception ability modifier.

effects.text: When you roll Combat Sequence, you and creatures within 30 feet gain a bonus equal to your Perception modifier. Affects one other creature, plus one more per additional rank.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of three times, each time you take it increases the amount of creature you can affect by one.

name: Efficient Diagnosis
description: You know where and why it hurts. Whenever you use a stimpak, first aid kit, or doctor’s bag on another creature; they heal an additional 2 hit points, alternatively you can flip one of your karma caps to heal double the amount you normally would.

effects.text: Stimpak, first aid kit or doctor's bag used on another creature heals an additional 2 HP per rank, or flip a Karma Cap to heal double.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of three times, each time increasing the number healed by 2.

name: Pack Rat
description: Each player character’s carry load increases by 10. Additionally, any item you carry that has a load less than 3 is reduced to 1.

effects.text: Applies to each player character's carry load (+10 per rank). Items you carry with a load less than 3 count as load 1.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of three times, each time increasing each player character’s carry load by 10.

name: Splash Damage
description: When you're deep in enemy territory, you just start chucking grenades and hope for the best. Whenever you attack with a weapon or equipment that has an area of effect, the area is increased by half.

effects.text: Area of effect of your attacks is increased by half; a second rank doubles the area.

repeat.text: If you take this perk again, area of effect size is increased by half (effectively doubling your area of effect size).

name: Careful Detonations
description: Whenever you throw an explosive that isn’t placed, you can choose a 5 foot radius area. Any creatures or objects in that 5 foot area take no damage and do not suffer any effects from the explosive. Alternatively, whenever you throw or detonate an explosive; you can choose for the area of effect radius to be up to 5 feet smaller.

effects.text: Thrown, unplaced explosives: exclude a 5 foot radius from the effect, or reduce the area of effect radius by up to 5 feet.

name: Pulsion Perforation
description: Your shots pierce right through your enemies! Whenever you make an attack roll with an energy weapon, you can choose to have the attack target up to three creatures that are in a line. The line is drawn starting from your location.

effects.text: Energy weapon attacks can target up to three creatures in a line; a second rank raises it to six.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of twice. If you take this perk again you can target up to six creatures in a line.

name: Demolitions Expert
description: You are an expert when it comes to the fine art of handling explosives. Whenever you deal damage with an explosive, the damage is increased by an additional dice.

effects.text: Damage dealt with an explosive is increased by one additional die per rank.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of three times.

name: Hit the Deck
description: You react very quickly to the word "incoming". Whenever you take damage to your stamina points from an explosive, the damage is halved.

effects.text: Explosive damage to your stamina points is halved.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of once.

name: Meltdown
description: Whenever you deal enough damage to bring another creature to 0 hit points from an attack roll made with a weapon that deals laser, plasma, or electricity damage; you can choose for that creature to explode with a corona of energy. Each creature within 10 feet of that creature takes damage equal to the amount you dealt.

effects.text: When a laser, plasma or electricity weapon attack brings a creature to 0 HP, it can explode: each creature within 10 feet takes damage equal to the amount you dealt.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of once.

name: Sniper
description: Whenever you spend action points to make an attack roll with a two-handed ranged weapon, you can spend 1 additional action point to add 2 to the result of the roll. You can spend up to 3 additional action points to add an additional 2 to the attack per action point used. Additionally, if you make a targeted attack roll to the head with a rifle that has the Scope mod, you critically hit on the attack roll, and you deal damage to the target’s hit points; the target dies so long as it can’t live without its head, or isn’t wearing a power armor helmet.

effects.text: Two-handed ranged weapon attacks: spend 1 extra AP to add 2 to the attack roll, up to 3 extra AP (+6 total). A targeted head attack with a scoped rifle critically hits and kills a target that can't live without its head and has no power armor helmet.

name: Volatile Hucker
description: Whenever you spend action points to throw an explosive, you spend 1 less action point to a minimum of 3. Additionally, if you roll a 20 on your Explosives skill check, the explosive explodes at the end of your turn and deals extra damage equal to double the damage dice.

effects.text: Throwing an explosive costs 1 less AP (minimum 3). On a natural 20 on the Explosives check, the explosive detonates at the end of your turn and deals extra damage equal to double the damage dice.

name: Medicinal Master
description: When another creature rests for at least an hour, you can use a first aid kit, stimpak, or doctor’s bag to heal them of half of their total hit points. If they rest for at least 4 hours, you you can use a first aid kit, stimpak, or doctor’s bag to heal them of all their hit points

effects.text: When another creature rests 1 hour, heal half of its total HP with a first aid kit, stimpak or doctor's bag; after 4 hours of rest, heal all of it. Second rank: heal all HP after 1 hour.

repeat.text: If you take this perk again, when another creature rests for at least an hour, you can use a first aid kit, stimpak, or doctor’s bag to heal them of all their hit points.

name: Oracle
description: Your predictions for trouble are supernatural. Whenever you roll Combat Sequence, you can swap the combat sequence rolls of any number of willing creatures.

effects.text: When you roll Combat Sequence, swap the rolls of any number of willing creatures. Second rank: up to three additional creatures, which need not be willing.

repeat.text: If you take this perk again, whenever you roll Combat Sequence, you can swap the combat sequence rolls of up to three additional creatures (they do not have to be willing).

name: Master Chef
description: You know how to spice up any meal. You can spend 5 minutes cooking pre-made food, or whenever you make cooked food; it always has the filling property, if it has the bland property it instead has the tasty property, and any creature who consumes the food gains temporary stamina points equal to their level.

effects.text: Cooked food you make always has the filling property, and bland food becomes tasty. Creatures eating it gain temporary stamina points equal to their level.

name: Lifegiver
description: Your maximum hit points increase by 10 and each other player character’s maximum hit points increase by 1.

effects.text: Each other player character's maximum hit points increase by 1 per rank.

repeat.text: If you take this perk again, your maximum hit points increase by 10 and each other player character’s maximum hit points increase by 1.

name: Toughness
description: Your DT increases by 1 and whenever you become frightened, you can always choose to be frightened (fight).

effects.text: Whenever you become frightened, you can always choose to be frightened (fight).

repeat.text: If you take this perk again, your DT increases by 1.

name: Beyond the Sea
description: Whenever you spend action points to move through water, you can spend 1 action point to move 5 feet instead of 10. Additionally, drinking dirty water does not give you any irradiated levels.

effects.text: Moving through water: 1 AP moves you 10 feet instead of 5 (ERRATA E19). Drinking dirty water gives no irradiated levels.

name: Mad Dash
description: Whenever you spend action points on your turn to sprint, you move 80 feet in a line instead of 50.

effects.text: Sprinting moves you 80 feet in a line instead of 50.

name: Trailblazer’s Instinct
description: When you start traveling, once per day you can roll a Survival skill check with the DC equal to 12. The DC increases by 2 if the route you are taking moves through difficult terrain, is longer than 3 days of travel, or is in unfamiliar territory. On a successful roll, you and each other creature you are traveling with move faster by 2 miles per hour. Additionally, you have advantage on any encounter rolls.

effects.text: Once per day when you start traveling, roll Survival DC 12 (+2 for difficult terrain, a route over 3 days, or unfamiliar territory); on success you and your travel companions move 2 miles per hour faster. You also have advantage on encounter rolls.

name: Survivorship Bias
description: Your know-how of other creatures and what they can do allows you to have an edge against them. Whenever you can sense another creature, so long as you have rolled combat sequence with the creature type and subtype before; you can spend 3 action points to learn either the hit point, stamina point, action point, AC, or DT total of any of them. Additionally, you can spend 6 action points to learn one of its attacks, or any weaknesses it has (if any).

effects.text: Against a creature whose type and subtype you have rolled combat sequence with: spend 3 AP to learn its HP, SP, AP, AC or DT, or 6 AP to learn one attack or weakness. Each additional rank (max 3) lets you learn one more statistic, action or weakness.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of three times. Each time you take this perk you learn an additional statistic, action, or weakness when using your action points.

name: Grit
description: Whenever you are dying, movement does not cost any extra action points and you gain an additional action point at the start of your turn.

effects.text: While dying, movement costs no extra AP and you gain 1 additional AP at the start of your turn (2 additional in total at the second rank; ERRATA E18).

repeat.text: If you take this perk again, you gain 2 additional action points at the start of your turn while you’re dying.

name: The Long Road
description: While traveling, you and each player character can travel an additional hour without gaining a level of exhaustion. Additionally, you gain all of your stamina points after resting for an hour instead of eight.

effects.text: While traveling, you and each PC can travel an additional hour before gaining a level of exhaustion. You regain all stamina points after resting 1 hour instead of 8.

name: Alive and Kickin’
description: Your energetic spirit can go the extra mile! You ignore the negative effects of the first three levels of exhaustion.

effects.text: You ignore the negative effects of the first three levels of exhaustion.

name: Solar Powered
description: Whenever you rest for at least an hour in direct sunlight, you gain temporary stamina points equal to your level. Additionally, you can use this solar power to charge your weapons. Whenever you roll damage, you can lose any number of temporary stamina points gained from this perk to increase the damage by an amount equal to the temporary stamina points lost.

effects.text: After resting at least 1 hour in direct sunlight, gain temporary stamina points equal to your level. When rolling damage, you can lose any number of those temporary stamina points to add that much damage.

name: Roughin’ It
description: You're more at home under the open stars than under a roof. Whenever you rest outside for at least 1 hour, you gain temporary hit points and temporary stamina points equal to your level for the next 8 hours.

effects.text: After resting outside for at least 1 hour, gain temporary HP and SP equal to your level for 8 hours. Second rank: other creatures of your choice resting with you gain the same bonus.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of twice. When you take it again, each other creature of your choice who also rests with you gains the same bonus.

name: Pure Determination
description: When you fall to 0 hit points for the first time on a turn, you can flip one of your Karma Caps to heal a number of hit points equal to your healing rate. Additionally, you are immune to the shock condition.

effects.text: The first time each turn you fall to 0 HP, you can flip a Karma Cap to heal HP equal to your healing rate.

name: Quick Recovery
description: You can spend 3 action points on your turn to heal a number of stamina points or hit points equal to your healing rate. Once you use this ability, you cannot use it again until you rest for at least 6 hours. Additionally, whenever you heal hit points, you gain a bonus equal to your Endurance modifier.

effects.text: Spend 3 AP to heal SP or HP equal to your healing rate (once until you rest 6 hours). Whenever you heal hit points, you gain a bonus equal to your Endurance modifier.

name: Implant Y-7
description: Your maximum hit points increase by a number equal to double your level. Additionally, your Healing Rate increases by 2.

name: NEMEAN Sub-Dermal Armor
description: You can spend 3 action points to activate your implant, when you do; you gain resistance to any three types of damage of your choice (acid, bludgeoning, ballistic, cold, electricity, explosive, fire, impact, laser, piercing, plasma, poison, radiation, or slashing) This lasts for 3 rounds (or 15 seconds). After which, you cannot activate your implant again until you rest for at least 1 hour or roll combat sequence.

effects.text: Pick-time/use-time choice: spend 3 AP to gain resistance to three damage types of your choice for 3 rounds; then unusable until you rest 1 hour or roll combat sequence.

name: Indomitable Spirit
description: When you roll combat sequence, you and any creatures of your choice gain temporary hit points equal to your Endurance modifier. Additionally, you can spend 3 action points on a dying creature within 5 feet of you, if you do they succeed one death save.

effects.text: When you roll combat sequence, you and creatures of your choice gain temporary HP equal to your Endurance modifier. Spend 3 AP on a dying creature within 5 feet to give it one successful death save.

name: PHOENIX Implant
description: You can spend 3 action points to activate your implant, when you do; you heal a number of hit points at the start of your turn equal to your healing rate. This lasts for 6 rounds (or 30 seconds). After which, you cannot activate your implant again until you rest for at least 1 hour or roll combat sequence.

effects.text: Spend 3 AP to activate: heal HP equal to your healing rate at the start of each of your turns for 6 rounds. Unusable again until you rest 1 hour or roll combat sequence.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of once.

name: Savvy Salesman
description: Whenever you purchase an item, the price is reduced by a percentage number equal to 2 x your Charisma ability score.

effects.text: Purchases are cheaper by a percentage equal to 2 x your Charisma score.

name: Party Animal
description: Nobody has a good time like you! You cannot become addicted to Alcohol and whenever you drink an alcoholic drink, you regain a number of stamina points equal to your level.

effects.text: You cannot become addicted to Alcohol. When you drink an alcoholic drink, regain stamina points equal to your level.

name: Flaunt ‘n Taunt
description: You’re good at causing a scene! You can spend 3 action points on your turn to taunt a target creature. Roll a Charisma check, that creature must succeed a Charisma ability check with the DC being equal to your check total. If they fail; the next attack roll against the taunted creature that isn’t from you has advantage. Additionally on their next turn they can only target you with their attacks. If you try to taunt a creature you have previously taunted, they have advantage on their Charisma check. You cannot taunt a creature more than twice.

effects.text: Spend 3 AP to taunt a creature (Charisma check vs. its Charisma ability check, DC = your total). On a failure, the next attack against it from anyone else has advantage and on its next turn it can only target you. A previously taunted creature has advantage on its check. No creature can be taunted more than twice.

name: Dealer's Choice
description: You’ve got a way with selling even the most useless scrap. Whenever you sell an item, you can sell it for 75% of the price instead of 50%.

effects.text: You sell items for 75% of their price instead of 50%.

name: Poker Face
description: You are totally unreadable. Whenever you roll a Speech skill check and the result is lower than 9, the total is instead equal to 9 + your Speech bonus. Additionally, whenever you gamble in a game of cards or dice; you can add your Charisma ability score to the roll.

effects.text: A Speech skill check total lower than 9 becomes 9 + your Speech bonus. When gambling at cards or dice, add your Charisma score to the roll.

name: Battle Cry
description: You can spend 3 AP on your to encourage your allies, let out a battle cry, or otherwise instigate victory! Each creature of your choice within 20 feet of you gains 2 additional action points to a maximum of 15. Additionally, each chosen creature gains advantage on their first attack roll on their turn. Once you use this ability you cannot use it again until you roll combat sequence again.

effects.text: Spend 3 AP: each creature of your choice within 20 feet gains 2 AP (max 15) and advantage on their first attack roll on their turn. Usable again after you next roll combat sequence.

name: Animal Friend
description: While in Combat, you will not be targeted by Animals or Insects unless all other targets are out of sight or unconscious.

effects.text: In combat, Animals and Insects don't target you unless all other targets are out of sight or unconscious.

name: Synergizing Teamwork
description: Whenever another party member fails an attack roll, you can flip one of your Karma Caps to add a bonus equal to your Charisma ability modifier. If the attack hits, the next creature to make an attack roll for the first time on their turn gains a bonus equal to your Charisma ability modifier plus 1. This ability continues to trigger until a party member misses their first attack roll on their turn.

effects.text: When another party member fails an attack roll, flip a Karma Cap to add your Charisma modifier to it. If it hits, the next creature to attack for the first time on their turn gains your Charisma modifier + 1. Keeps triggering until a party member misses their first attack roll on their turn.

name: Ferocious Loyalty
description: The power of your personality inspires die-hard loyalty from your followers. When you first take damage to your hit points, your party members can regain all their stamina points so long as they can sense you. Once this ability triggers it doesn’t trigger again until you rest for at least 8 hours.

effects.text: The first time you take damage to your hit points, party members who can sense you regain all their stamina points. Doesn't trigger again until you rest 8 hours. Only one PC in the party can take this perk.

repeat.text: Once a player character has taken this perk, it cannot be taken by any other characters.

name: Back to Back
description: Shoulder to shoulder. When you roll combat sequence, choose one ally. When you and that ally are within 5 feet of each other, you and that ally gain the following benefits; Your AC increases by 1, your DT increases by 2, and whenever either you or the chosen ally take damage, either you or that ally can choose to reduce that damage by half. Then, they take the same amount of damage.

effects.text: When you roll combat sequence, choose an ally. While within 5 feet of each other, you both get +1 AC and +2 DT, and when either takes damage, either of you can halve it so the other takes the same amount. Rank 2 (party-limited, one PC): +2 AC and +4 DT in total, and the damage can be reduced to 0 with the other taking it instead.

repeat.text: Once a player character has taken this perk, it cannot be taken by any other characters. If you take this perk again, the AC bonus increases by 1, the DT bonus increases by 2, and whenever you or that ally take damage, either you or that ally can choose to reduce that damage to 0. Then, they take the damage instead.

name: Big Ego
description: With all that charm, even YOU know why you’re so great! Your Party Nerve modifier is doubled for you.

effects.text: Your Party Nerve modifier is doubled for you.

name: Inspiring Action
description: You can spend 3 AP on your turn to inspire a creature within 30 feet. That creature can add 2d10 to any d20 roll they make for the next minute. Once they use the 2d10, they cannot use it again. Once you inspire a creature, you cannot inspire them again until the next day.

effects.text: Spend 3 AP to inspire a creature within 30 feet: for 1 minute it can add 2d10 to one d20 roll. A given creature can be inspired once per day.

name: Terrifying Presence
description: During the first round of combat, regardless if you are first, you intimidate your opponents with threats. Each enemy that can see you in the combat sequence with an intelligence higher than 2 must becomes frightened (see page #).

effects.text: In the first round of combat, each enemy that can see you and has Intelligence above 2 becomes frightened.

name: Legend of the Wastelander
description: Stories of you are heard from around the wasteland. Your Party Nerve negatively affects any enemies’ Stamina Points that you are in combat with. Yes, even if they’re a creature incapable of comprehending the idea of a legend.

effects.text: Your Party Nerve applies negatively to the Stamina Points of enemies you are in combat with, even creatures that can't comprehend legends.

name: Empowering Personality
description: You lead by example, whenever another creature within 30 feet of you deals damage from an attack roll; you can flip one of your Karma Caps to increase the damage by a bonus equal to double your Charisma ability modifier. Additionally, whenever another creature takes damage to their hit points, you can flip one of your Karma Caps to reduce this damage by an amount equal to double your Charisma ability modifier.

effects.text: Flip a Karma Cap when another creature within 30 feet deals attack damage to add double your Charisma modifier to it, or when another creature takes damage to its hit points to reduce it by double your Charisma modifier.

name: Commander
description: You can spend 3 AP to give any allied creature within 60 feet of you a command. That creature immediately gains 6 AP to complete the described action immediately. These action points do not remain or are not recycled after the command is completed.

effects.text: Spend 3 AP to command an allied creature within 60 feet; it immediately gains 6 AP (not retained or recycled) to carry out the command.

name: Cunning Strategist
description: Whenever another player character flips their Karma Cap back over when they roll a 1 on a d20 or if they are hit with a critical hit, you can also flip over your Karma Cap.

effects.text: When another PC flips their Karma Cap back over after rolling a 1 on a d20 or being critically hit, you can flip yours back over too. Second rank: you can instead choose another PC to flip their Karma Cap back over.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of twice, when you take it again; whenever another player character flips their Karma Cap back over when they roll a 1 on a d20 or if they are hit with a critical hit, you can choose for another player character to flip over their Karma Cap.

name: Celebrity
description: Everybody knows who you are! People around the wasteland go crazy just to meet you! You get free drinks at bars and you have a permanent 20% discount on all items. Whenever you meet an NPC who isn’t hostile, in neutral standing towards you, or directly affiliated with a faction; you may roll a Luck check with the DC equal to 30 - your Speech or Barter skill bonus. On a success, the NPC knows who you are. You gain advantage on all Charisma based skill checks with this NPC. Additionally, you can lose your Karma Cap to have this NPC follow you and your party. Obeying orders from you (within reason), but won’t outright hurt or kill themselves. If you dismiss this NPC, or they die; you gain your Karma Cap back at the beginning of the next game session.

effects.text: Free drinks at bars and a permanent 20% discount on all items. Meeting a neutral or unaffiliated NPC: Luck check, DC 30 - your Speech or Barter bonus; on a success they know you and you have advantage on Charisma-based skill checks with them. You can lose your Karma Cap to have that NPC follow the party (regained next session if dismissed or dead).

name: Stand and Fight
description: Whenever another creature within 30 feet of you fails a death save and dies, you can turn that roll into a success. Once you use this ability on a creature, you cannot use it on them again until you roll combat sequence.

effects.text: When a creature within 30 feet fails a death save and dies, turn that roll into a success. Once used on a creature, not again on them until you roll combat sequence.

name: Retention
description: Whenever another player character succeeds a Barter, Breach, Crafting, Intimidation, Medicine, Science, Sneak, Speech, or Survival skill check, you gain a +3 to that skill check the next time you roll it (up to a maximum of +3). Additionally, whenever you read a Skill Magazine, its effects last for 8 hours instead of 1.

name: Math Wrath
description: Whenever you make a targeted attack, you can spend half the amount of additional AP (rounded up). Additionally, you can make a special attack with a ranged weapon on your turn called a Calculated attack. This attack costs 6 action points regardless of the weapon’s action point cost. When you make a Calculated attack, you can target a creature behind cover or otherwise out of sight so long as there is a plane or surface in which your projectile can ricochet off of (up to GM’s discretion). When you roll damage from a Calculated attack, the damage is reduced by 1 for every 10 feet the projectile travels after ricocheting.

name: Adroit Alchemist
description: You understand the complex formulae of chems and can now alter them to change their effects. Whenever you craft a Chem, you use one less material listed in the crafting materials to a minimum of one. You can also make any Chem potent or diluted so long as you use one of the materials listed in the crafting materials. A potent Chem’s effects are doubled, however the addiction DC is increased by 2. A diluted Chem’s effects are halved, however you cannot become addicted to a diluted Chem.

name: Patch Up
description: You can heal a creature up to their healing rate. Once you heal in this way, that creature can only be healed again after resting for at least 8 hours.

name: Explorer
description: Whenever you rest and gain a bonus of XP after having discovered new locations, you gain an additional 50% bonus of XP. Additionally; you can learn the direction and distance of any three named locations, to the GM’s discretion.

name: Weatherboy!
description: You always know which way is north, what the weather will be for the next three days, and whether the area you’re traveling in is populated or empty (which determines encounters).

name: On-the-Go Mechanic
description: Whenever you craft an item, you no longer need a workbench. However, you need to keep your tools on you. Your tools are 5 Load.

name: Light Touch
description: You know how to specially craft your armor to fit you to grant you more flexibility and protection. When you take damage and are reduced to 0 hit points, your Armor only decays 1 level. Additionally; whenever you take damage to your hit points, you can have your armor absorb the blow. The damage is reduced to 0 but your armor decays by 1 level for every 10 damage absorbed.

name: Chemist
description: You know exactly what they put in those chems. The duration of any chems you take last twice as long and you have advantage on resisting addiction.

name: Efficient Munitions
description: Whenever you craft any type of ammunition, the attack and damage rolls made with this ammunition are increased by 2. Alternatively, you can forgo this bonus to instead; double the amount of ammunition you craft whenever you craft any type of ammunition.

name: Nerd Rage!
description: You've been pushed around long enough! Whenever you start your turn with less than half your total hit points, your DT increases by 2.

name: In Shining Armor
description: You’ve upgraded your armor with reflective material. You have resistance to laser and plasma damage. Additionally; each time you are hit with laser or plasma damage; roll a Luck check. On an 19 or higher the beam refracts and hits the attacker, dealing the same damage to them.

name: Computer Whiz
description: Whenever you fail a Breach skill check on a computer, you can spend 10 minutes to automatically succeed the check instead (up to GM’s discretion).

name: Robotic Expert:
description: You ignore 2 points of damage threshold when dealing damage to Robots. Additionally, you can attempt to shut down robots with a successful Science check, the DC is equal to the Robots Intelligence score + 10. You cannot shut down robots if you are in combat with them.

name: Quick Repair
description: You can spend 6 action points to Quick repair. Quick repair removes two levels of decay from an item. Once you Quick repair, you cannot do it again until you rest for at least 8 hours.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of three times. When you take it again you can Quick repair an additional time per 8 hour rest.

name: Remedial Atomizer
description: You can spend 6 action points and two stimpaks to cause each non-robotic creature within 20 feet of you to regain hit points equal to their healing rate. Alternatively, you can spend 6 action points and two robot repair kits to cause each robotic creature within 20 feet of you to regain hit points equal to their healing rate.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of twice. If you take this perk again, you can use four stimpaks or robot repair kits to have each creature heal double their healing rate.

name: Overcharge
description: When you spend action points to make an attack roll with a ranged weapon, you can spend up to 3 additional AP to add a number of additional damage dice to the damage. The number of additional damage dice that are added is equal to the amount of extra AP spent. You can only use this ability once per turn.

name: Expert Engineer
description: Whenever you craft an item, you use two less materials for each material listed to a minimum of one.

name: Quick Draw
description: Whenever you spend action points to equip or stow an item, it costs 2 less to a minimum of 1.

name: Action Hero
description: Your action point maximum increases by 2 to a maximum of 15.

name: Fan the Hammer
description: Whenever you attack with a revolver, you can flip one of your Karma Caps and spend 10 AP to make a number of additional attacks without spending any additional AP, the target of these attacks must be within 10 feet of the previous target. The number of attacks you can make is equal to the rounds you have left in the revolver.

name: Rapid Reload
description: Whenever you spend AP to reload or take cover, it costs you 3 less to a minimum of 1. Additionally, when you reload a weapon that has Manual Reload, you can spend 1 AP to reload three rounds.

name: Reaction Reactor
description: If you end your turn with at least 3 unused action points, you can use them at the end of another creature's turn. If you do not use them, you recycle all of them at the beginning of your next turn.

name: The Dance
description: Whenever you roll damage from an attack made with a bladed melee weapon, you can choose to add your Agility ability modifier to the damage instead of your Strength ability modifier.

name: Nimble Dash
description: Whenever you spend action points on your turn to sprint, you do not stop your movement when small barriers block you. Instead you can spend 10 feet of that movement to vault over or slide under the barrier. Additionally, if you spent all of your action points on a turn to sprint, all attack rolls made against you have disadvantage until the start of your next turn.

name: Evasive Action
description: Whenever you take damage to your stamina points for the first time after rolling combat sequence, the damage is reduced to 0.

name: Gunslinger
description: Whenever you make an attack roll with a handgun, add 2 to the result. Additionally, whenever you hit a creature with a targeted attack roll to the head with a handgun, you can flip one of your Karma Caps to turn the hit into a critical hit. Once you use this ability, you cannot use it again until you roll combat sequence again.

name: And Stay Back
description: Whenever you deal damage to a creature with a shotgun, you ignore 2 points of DT. Additionally, the target is within 5 feet of you; you can choose to knock them back 15 feet away from you.

name: Multitarget Hotshot
description: Whenever you hit a creature with a ranged attack, your next ranged attack roll is increased by 2 so long as you target a different creature. After this second attack, if you target a different creature than the previous two attacks, the attack roll is increased by 4. After this third attack, you cannot gain the initial increase of 2 until you make another ranged attack. Clarification: You can make one normal ranged attack, then if you target another creature, you get +2. If you target another different creature, you get +4. Then, the bonus resets. You need to attack a creature without this perk’s bonus to start the +2 to +4 cycle again. Further clarification, you do not need to make these attacks all on one turn.

name: Ninja
description: You can spend 5 action points on your turn to perform a spinning attack, this attack targets 3 creatures that are within 5 feet of you and acts as an unarmed attack. Additionally, whenever you attack with a melee weapon or unarmed attack; your crit chance decreases by 2.

name: Concentrated Fire
description: Whenever you hit with a targeted attack roll, you can choose the limb condition. Additionally, your attack rolls against creatures are increased by 2 for each limb condition they have.

name: Mister Sandman
description: Bring me a dream! If you attack an unconscious creature, they die.

name: Ranger’s Deadly Aim
description: If you are the first to act in combat sequence, you can choose for your first attack roll to critically hit or, you can attack up to three times without spending any AP.

name: Group Camouflage
description: Your Group Sneak score is equal to 20, as are any allies within 30 feet of you.

name: Efficient Speedster
description: You recycle all your unused Action Points at the start of your turn, additionally whenever you sprint you can turn your direction once and continue sprinting.

name: Anticipated Reflexes
description: Whenever an attack beats your AC and hits you, you can choose to spend 3 Action Points to increase your AC by 1, 6 Action Points to increase your AC by 2, or 9 Action Points to increase your AC by 3. However, at the start of your next turn you will regain less Action Points equal to the amount you spent.

name: Nerves of Steel
description: At the start of each of your turns, so long as your hit point total isn’t below half, you regain stamina points equal to half your level (rounded down).

name: Scrounger
description: Whenever you make a Luck ability check to determine the loot you find, you can roll two checks and choose which result to take.

name: Big Crits
description: The critical hits you cause in combat are more devastating. If you roll a 20 on an attack roll with a weapon, you critically hit and the crit’s damage is doubled.

name: Bloody Mess
description: Whenever you deal damage with a weapon, the damage increases by 2. Additionally, whenever you reduce a creature to 0 hit points with a weapon attack, roll a Luck check with the DC equal to 20. If you succeed, the creature’s body bursts. Each creature of your choice within 30 feet of the explosion becomes frightened for 1 round.

name: Fortune Finder
description: When you take this perk, you suddenly come into possession of 800 caps! Additionally, whenever you find bottle caps, you find a number more equal to your Luck ability modifier.

name: Make it Double
description: You gain an additional Karma Cap.

name: It Just Works
description: Whenever any of your weapons or armor would gain a level of decay, roll a Luck check with the DC equal to 12 + the current levels of decay on the weapon or armor. If you fail, the weapon or armor gains a level of decay. If you succeed the weapon or armor still gains a level of decay, but this level of decay doesn’t apply any negative effects for as long as you have it.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of twice, if you take it again; whenever you succeed the aforementioned Luck check, the weapon or armor gains no levels of decay instead.

name: On a Fluke!
description: Whenever you or another party member misses an attack, or fails an ability or skill check; you can flip one of your Karma Caps to turn it into a success (at GM’s discretion).

name: Grim Reaper's Sprint
description: Whenever you bring a creature to 0 hit points with a targeted attack, you immediately gain 8 action points. If you bring another creature to 0 hit points with a targeted attack on the same turn, you immediately gain 6 action points. If you bring a third creature to 0 hit points with a targeted attack on the same turn, you immediately gain 4 action points.

name: Spray and Pray
description: You can liberally blast areas with reckless abandon. Whenever you make a blind attack, you have advantage on the attack roll. Additionally, the blind attack DC is halved.

name: Randomizer
description: Whenever you craft or repair an item, you can randomly choose one of the required materials, the required material is reduced by an amount equal to your Luck ability modifier to a minimum of 1. The required material is also replaced by a randomly chosen junk material. Additionally, whenever you consume a food, drink, or chem, you can choose to roll a Luck ability check with the DC equal to 15, if you succeed; one random food, drink, or chem property is added to the consumed food, drink, or chem.

name: Critical Banker
description: Whenever you roll a critical hit, you can choose to deal no extra damage. If you do, you gain a temporary karma cap that you lose when flipped. If you use this temporary karma cap on an attack roll, the attack is automatically a critical hit. You can only have a maximum of one temporary karma cap.

name: Ricochet
description: What goes around comes around! Whenever another creature makes an attack roll against you, and they roll a 1, the attack hits them instead. Additionally, whenever another creature makes an attack roll within 30 feet of you, you can flip one of your Karma Caps to turn the attack roll’s result into a 1.

name: Mysterious Stranger
description: You have the protection of the wasteland’s guardian angel. Choose a number from 2 to 19. Whenever you make an attack roll and the result is the chosen number, the Mysterious Stranger appears! When he appears, roll a d20 (you can choose to add your Luck ability modifier to this roll) and consult the table below. Luck Check Effect 1-9 The target of the attack roll takes ballistic damage equal to 2 x your level. 10 - 20 The target of the attack roll takes ballistic damage equal to 3 x your level. 21 - 24 Your attack becomes a critical hit. If it was already a critical hit; you do not roll your damage dice and instead deal the maximum amount on each dice. 25+ The target of the attack roll dies.

repeat.text: This perk can only be taken once and only by one player character.

name: Dumb Luck
description: There is no sense to your life’s aptitude. Your full Luck ability modifier is added to all your skill modifiers instead of half. Additionally, whenever you flip your Karma Cap to gain advantage on an ability or skill check, you can add double your Luck modifier to the total.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of twice, if you take it again; all your skill modifiers increase by 2. Additionally, whenever you flip your Karma Cap to gain reroll an ability or skill check, you can add double your Luck modifier to the second roll.

name: Been There, Done That
description: Whenever you or an ally within 100 feet of you makes a Luck ability check, it is increased by 3. Additionally, whenever you gain XP you gain a bonus equal to a 5d10 + every player character Luck scored added together, then halved.

name: Fortune Favors the Bold
description: Whenever you or any other player characters flip your Karma Cap to gain advantage or a reroll on an ability check, skill check, or attack roll, physically flick and flip your Karma Cap. If it lands facing up then it stays facing up.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of once. If any other player character takes this perk, and if your Karma Cap lands face down; you can physically flip a number of times equal to the amount of player characters who have taken this perk past the first.

name: Outrageous Advantage
description: Whenever you or any other player characters roll an ability check, skill check, or attack roll with advantage; you roll three d20’s instead of two and choose the highest result.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of once. If any other player character takes this perk, the amount of d20’s rolled with advantage increases by one.

name: Never Tell Me the Odds
description: Whenever another creature hits you with an attack, you can flip one of your Karma Caps to turn the hit into a miss. Additionally, whenever you have the dying condition all attacks roll against you automatically miss.

name: Cannibal
description: You dine on the most taboo of meats. Whenever you consume the flesh of a human, ghoul, or super mutant that has died within the past 15 minutes, you heal a number of hit points equal to double your healing rate, once you heal in this way you cannot heal from it again until you rest for at least 8 hours. If you consume prepared human or ghoul flesh, you heal a number of stamina points equal to your level.

name: Old World Gourmet
description: Thanks to unclean living you've learned the secrets of the lounge lizards! Food and Drinks no longer give you Irradiated levels.

name: Hunter’s Wisdom
description: Whenever you take damage from attacks made from animals or insects, your DT increases by 2. Additionally, whenever you consume the meat of an animal or insect that has died within the past 15 minutes, you heal a number of hit points equal to your healing rate, once you heal in this way you cannot heal from it again until you rest for at least 8 hours. If you consume prepared animal or insect meat, you heal a number of stamina points equal to your level.

name: Ghastly Scavenger
description: You dine on the rarest and most refined of strange meats. Whenever you consume the flesh of an abomination that has died within the past 15 minutes, you heal a number of hit points equal to double your healing rate, once you heal in this way you cannot heal from it again until you rest for at least 8 hours. If you consume prepared abomination flesh, you heal a number of stamina points equal to your level.

name: Computer Cousin
description: Robots will not target you with attacks unless you are the only hostile target within 60 feet. Additionally, you have advantage on Breach skill checks with any computer.

name: Partition Reset
description: Reduce any of your ability scores by 1, 2, or 3. You can increase any other ability score by the amount you decreased plus 1.

name: Factory Reset
description: When you take this perk, your character becomes 1st level and gains all the XP you previously had. You can rebuild your character and choose new traits, skills bonuses, ability scores, and perks. However, your memory is wiped and you remember nothing up to taking this perk.

name: Determination is not a Malfunction
description: You are immune to the frightened condition. Additionally, when you have unused action points at the end of your turn, you recycle all of them on your next turn.

name: Nuclear Reactor
description: While in an irradiated zone you have advantage on all ability and skill checks. Additionally, your AC increases by 1, your DT increases by 2, and you gain temporary hit points equal to your level.

name: Rad Absorption
description: With the Rad Absorption perk, your radiation level slowly decreases on its own over time. Every time you sleep, and you are not in an irradiated zone, your rad level decreases by one.

name: Rad-Tastic!
description: Your Radiation DC decreases by 3. Additionally, you ignore the negative effects of the first 3 levels of radiation.

name: Atomic!
description: While in an irradiated zone, you gain additional action points equal to your Endurance ability modifier to a maximum of 15. If your action points are already 15, any actions you take that cost 4 AP or more instead cost 1 less.

name: Springboard Recovery
description: On your turn you can spend 3 AP to heal a number of stamina points equal to your healing rate. Once you use this action, you cannot use it again until you rest for at least 6 hours.

name: Holey Moley
description: Your arms have some extra holes for aerodynamics! Once per turn, whenever you make an unarmed attack, you can spend 1 AP to make an additional one.

name: Chem Resistant
description: You no longer suffer the negative effects of addiction to chems. Additionally, syringes have no effect on you unless they are a stimpak or chem.

name: Eye for an Eye
description: Finger for a finger. Whenever another creature deals damage to your hit points for the first time on a turn, that creature becomes marked. The next time you attack and hit the marked creature, it is automatically a critical hit. If the hit was already a critical hit, the damage you deal is doubled. Once a creature becomes marked, another creature cannot become marked until you rest.

name: Stitched Together
description: Your body has seen the worst the wasteland has to offer. If you ever lose any of your limbs, besides your head, you can spend 5 minutes reattaching the limb so long as you have a first aid kit and you still have the limb you lost. Additionally, you can spend 1 minute to heal a number of hit points equal to your healing rate. Once you heal in this way, you cannot do it again until you rest for at least 6 hours.

name: Savage Sprint
description: You can spend 3 action points on your turn to sprint instead of 5. Additionally, whenever you long jump you can clear an additional 10 feet and whenever you high jump you can clear an additional 3 feet.

name: How do you do, fellow Ghouls?
description: Feral Ghouls will not target you with attacks unless you are the only hostile target within 60 feet. Additionally, you have advantage on Speech skill checks with any ghoul.

name: Can’t Put Me Down
description: Your DT increases by 1 and you gain advantage on all Death Saves. If you already have advantage on Death Saves, you roll three d20’s and take the highest result.

name: Reanimated
description: While you are dying, your speed is not halved and you gain an additional action point at the start of your turn. Additionally, when you die; you immediately gain 20 action points. Once these action points are used, or your turn ends; you die.

name: Pain Train
description: Choo Choo! All aboard! You can charge into enemies and knock them off their feet. If you sprint through another creature's space that has a Strength score equal to or less than yours; they are knocked prone.

name: Hardware Upgrade
description: You can choose any two weapons to become one of your Robot weapons, so long as you have the caps to purchase them, the materials to craft them, or own the weapons.

name: Thick Plating
description: Your AC and DT increase by 1.

repeat.text: You can take this perk up to a maximum of three times.

name: Adamantium Skeleton
description: You are immune to all limb conditions, and whenever you take damage to your hit points from a targeted attack; the damage is halved.

name: Light Step
description: You never set off placed explosives or traps.

name: Pump the Coolant
description: You can spend 6 action points on your turn to heal a number of stamina points equal to double your healing rate. Once you use this ability, you cannot use it again until you rest for at least 8 hours.

name: Reinforced Recovery
description: On your turn you can spend 6 AP to heal a number of hit points equal to your healing rate. Once you use this action, you cannot use it again until you sleep.

name: Fine-Toothed Giant
description: You no longer suffer the effects of the “Bulky” racial trait. Additionally, whenever you make a crafting check to repair an item, the DC is reduced by 5.

name: Wasteland Camel
description: You no longer require double the amount of water each day to avoid dehydration. Additionally, dirty water has the “hydrating” property for you.

name: No Gods, No Masters
description: Super mutants will not target you with attacks unless you are the only hostile target within 60 feet. Additionally, you can 3 AP on your turn and choose one target super mutant within 60 feet of you. You learn that target’s total ability scores.

name: Feel No Wounds
description: Your DT increases by 1. Additionally, if you end your turn with at least 6 AP; whenever you take damage to your hit points you can spend 6 AP to reduce the damage by half (rounded down).

name: Evolution
description: Your AC increases by 1, your DT increases by 1, your hit points increase by a number equal to your level, and your stamina points increase by a number equal to your level. Additionally, choose one damage type. Whenever you take that damage type to your hit points, the total amount is halved (rounded down).
